instruction: Candid documentary photograph, medium full shot from a low angle looking up an indoor marble staircase. A man with dark curly hair (R2) in a gray blazer and black pants stands on a lower step, wearing a tan backpack and pointing at a notebook. A woman with ginger hair (R1) wearing glasses, a dark blazer, and tan pants stands on a higher step, holding the open black notebook and looking down at him. They interact closely on the stairs. The background is brightly lit from above, creating a high-contrast, overexposed upper frame with neutral tones.
